$comment: Copy to keyforge.config.json (or set LICENSE_CONFIG to its path). Everything here is optional; these are illustrative values, not the defaults.

signingKeys.$comment: Public halves of keys this service no longer signs with. Tokens carry a kid, so a rotated-away key must stay findable while tokens it signed are still in the field. The active key comes from LICENSE_SIGNING_KEY and is named by LICENSE_SIGNING_KID.

auth.$comment: core = operator + session management; full adds bans and impersonation; or list features: [operators, sessions, bans, impersonation]
